booking_insights.ubereats: You get $10/month Uber Cash (enrolled automatically) usable on Uber Eats and Uber rides — effectively a free order each month. On top of that, Uber Eats orders still earn 4X MR as dining (4.0¢ per $1).

dining.note: Restaurants worldwide, including takeout and delivery in the U.S.

airline.note: Flights booked directly with airlines or on AmexTravel.com

hotel.note: Prepaid hotels and eligible travel booked through AmexTravel.com

ubereats.note: Earns 4X as dining, plus $10/month Uber Cash credit applies to Uber Eats orders

point_valuation.cpp_note: Using 1.0 cpp as default ranking value — reflects flight bookings via Amex Travel portal. Hotel portal bookings yield less (0.7 cpp); transfers to airline partners can exceed 1.0 cpp.

amex_travel_flights.note: Best portal redemption — use this for flight bookings on AmexTravel.com

amex_travel_hotels_prepaid.note: General prepaid hotel bookings on AmexTravel.com. Lower value — consider transfer partners instead.

fine_hotels_and_resorts.note: FHR bookings on AmexTravel.com. Better than standard hotel portal rate.

hotel_collection.note: The Hotel Collection (THC) — same 0.7 cpp but includes $100 on-property amenity credit on 2+ night stays, which offsets the lower cpp.

transfer_to_airline_partners.note: Transferring to airline partners (e.g., ANA, Air France/KLM, Delta, British Airways) typically yields ~1.0–2.0 cpp depending on the redemption.

transfer_to_hotel_partners.note: Transferring to Hilton Honors (1:2 ratio) or Choice Hotels can yield 1.0+ cpp. Better than booking hotels directly on Amex Travel portal.

point_valuation.best_practice: For hotels, transfer to Hilton Honors or book Fine Hotels & Resorts rather than standard Amex Travel prepaid hotels. For flights, book directly on AmexTravel.com or transfer to airline partners for premium cabin awards.
